name: OneLake catalog - Copilot for Semantic model summary
description: Fabric OneLake catalog now includes a feature that uses Copilot to create automatic summaries for your data. This innovative capability allows users to quickly understand what their data is about and gain valuable insights. By leveraging Copilot's AI capabilities, item owners can easily curate their items to make them more discoverable, enhance clarity and so to improve end-users decision-making process.
